scope: First-order static screening of the four DVDD Metal5 ECO bridges; NOT full PDN EM/IR signoff.

existing_partial_current_observations.use: These are partial analog test currents; not DVDD bridge current or complete chip current. No total or DVDD headroom is inferred.

limitations: R estimates cover an ideal uniform 1D segment, not spreading/current crowding, trunk paths, vias, bondwire/package or regulator impedance.
The high/low extraction corners are not a junction-temperature sweep.
Four-parallel value assumes equipotential trunks and equal sharing, which has not been solved.
Actual average/pulsed DVDD demand, per-bridge sharing and junction temperature are unknown.
No existing via count/current distribution audit or electrothermal/IR-drop simulation performed.
EM table applicability and lifetime conditions need manufacturer confirmation.
verdict: NO EM/IR PASS CLAIM; geometric screening only
